title: About
architecture: I start from constraints (user needs, operational context, project scope) rather than tools or trends. This tends to favor simpler architectures and systems that remain easy to reason about as they evolve.
systems: I consider deployment and security fundamentals as part of the design process. The goal is to build reliable applications with a predictable behavior under real conditions. This approach guided the design of my fullstack application (auth, payments, deployment pipeline).
background: Before moving into software development, I spent 20 years in hospitality and catering, including management roles. That experience shaped the way I work: handling real-time constraints, prioritizing under pressure. Moreover, it reinforced a pragmatic mindset: balancing ideal solutions with what is actually viable in practice.
